statement: The existing Linux Docker image built from a private source checkout grants its declared UID10001 read and traversal access to every runtime asset while retaining nonowner read-only code and writable owned /data, independent of host checkout umask.

constraints.statement: Normalize only image-local assembled runtime assets in the existing Docker builder. Preserve exact runtime input scope, USER10001, /data owner, base image references, immutable source and scenario bounds. No host chmod, root runtime, runtime code chown to app user, retries or fallback.

Actual failed original fa4888 remains failed. Candidate permission control does not establish formation, host certification, release or whole-corpus acceptance. Observed Docker Node22.22.0 satisfies package engines >=22.12.0; host Node22.23.2 is a separate runtime identity, not a demonstrated container version violation.
